\# {lovedial}❤️☎️ ![ Bright yellow hexsticker with a pink phallic phone;
the text 'lovedial' connects to the phone via a curly old-style phone
cord.](reference/figures/logo.png)

Guess who likes you in this secret admirer phone game.

## Installation

Run the following R command to install {lovedial}:

``` r

# install.packages("pak") # if not already installed
pak::pak("statsrhian/lovedial")
```

## Play

``` r

library("lovedial")
new_game()
```

    ── ☎  Lovedial ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    📞 Dial: dial(Name)
    ❌ Eliminate: eliminate(Name)
    ❓ Guess: guess(Name)
    👀 View board: view_board()

# Package index

## All functions

- [`dial()`](https://statsrhian.github.io/lovedial/reference/dial.md) :
  Call a person
- [`eliminate()`](https://statsrhian.github.io/lovedial/reference/eliminate.md)
  : Eliminate a person
- [`guess()`](https://statsrhian.github.io/lovedial/reference/guess.md)
  : Guess a person
- [`make_people()`](https://statsrhian.github.io/lovedial/reference/make_people.md)
  : Creates a list of 24 people from the people_meta
- [`new_game()`](https://statsrhian.github.io/lovedial/reference/new_game.md)
  : New game Creates a new game with admirer and clue set
